title: Continuation of Coverage for Ongoing Therapy during a Member Appeals Program Appeal
content:
**Statement.** This statement applies when the member's Northbridge Appeals package provides concurrent care continuation, and the appeal under the Member Appeals Program concerns an ongoing therapy whose coverage was reduced or ended, whether by a renewal denial or by a mid-year removal. In that case, the drug stays covered at its prior status while the appeal is pending. Coverage of a new therapy never continues during an appeal.

## Statement applied

| Therapy under appeal | How its coverage was affected | Coverage while the appeal is pending |
|---|---|---|
| Ongoing therapy | Renewal denied | Stays covered at its prior status |
| Ongoing therapy | Removed mid-year | Stays covered at its prior status |
| New therapy | First request denied | Coverage does not continue during the appeal |

## Cases (hypothetical)

- **Renewal denial.** A member has taken a drug under an earlier approval, and the renewal is denied. The member appeals that denial. While the appeal is pending, the drug stays covered at its prior status.
- **Mid-year removal.** A drug the member is already taking is removed partway through the year, and the member appeals. The drug stays covered at its prior status while that appeal is pending.
- **New therapy.** A first request for a drug the member has not been taking is denied, and the member appeals. Coverage of that new therapy does not continue during the appeal.

The continuation lasts only while the appeal is pending. It concerns the drug whose coverage the appealed decision reduced or ended.
